name: keel
description: Evidence-backed operating system for private holdings and liquidity planning.

scripts.check: pnpm data:scan && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:check:local: wrangler d1 execute keel-local --env local --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS households FROM households; SELECT COUNT(*) AS snapshots FROM forecast_snapshots; SELECT COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals; SELECT COUNT(*) AS primary_goals FROM goals WHERE is_primary = 1 AND archived_at IS NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) AS goal_versions_without_snapshot FROM goal_versions version LEFT JOIN goal_forecast_snapshots snapshot ON snapshot.goal_version_id = version.id WHERE snapshot.id IS NULL;"
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply keel-local --env local --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute keel-local --env local --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --file packages/database/seed/synthetic.sql
